# Introduction

In this document I present the analyses pertaining to my "eCLIP.SE" pipeline. 

```{r}
# These are all the libraries I used throughout the analysis. Not all of them will be required on this guidebook
library(Rsubread)
library(limma)
library(edgeR)
library(DESeq2)
library(magrittr)
library(ggrepel)
library(tidyverse)
library(vsn)
library(ggplot2)
library(NMF)
library(biomaRt)
library(ggpubr)
library(factoextra)
library(ggfortify)
library(plotly)
library(reshape2)
library(fgsea)
library(msigdbr)
library(data.table)
```

# Vast Tools

# Loading up the data

```{r}
BigExon_Mapped <- as.data.table(BigExon_Mapped)
```

# Intron Mapping

## Data Preprocessing

```{r}
#Positive Stranded Introns
Intron_Mapped_plus[] <- lapply(Intron_Mapped_plus, function(x) gsub("[()<>]", "", x))
#UpsExon
Intron_Mapped_plus <- separate(Intron_Mapped_plus, scaled_values_UPS_EX, into = c("scaled_values_UPS_EX_ST", "scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN"), sep = ",", convert = TRUE)
Intron_Mapped_plus$scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN <- as.numeric(Intron_Mapped_plus$scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN)
#IntSt
Intron_Mapped_plus <- separate(Intron_Mapped_plus, scaled_values_IN_ST, into = c("scaled_values_IN_ST_ST", "scaled_values_IN_ST_EN"), sep = ",", convert = TRUE)
Intron_Mapped_plus$scaled_values_IN_ST_EN <- as.numeric(Intron_Mapped_plus$scaled_values_IN_ST_EN)
#IntEn
Intron_Mapped_plus <- separate(Intron_Mapped_plus, scaled_values_IN_EN, into = c("scaled_values_IN_EN_ST", "scaled_values_IN_EN_EN"), sep = ",", convert = TRUE)
Intron_Mapped_plus$scaled_values_IN_EN_EN <- as.numeric(Intron_Mapped_plus$scaled_values_IN_EN_EN)
#DowExon
Intron_Mapped_plus <- separate(Intron_Mapped_plus, scaled_values_DOW_EX, into = c("scaled_values_DOW_EX_ST", "scaled_values_DOW_EX_EN"), sep = ",", convert = TRUE)
Intron_Mapped_plus$scaled_values_DOW_EX_EN <- as.numeric(Intron_Mapped_plus$scaled_values_DOW_EX_EN)

Intron_Mapped_plus <- Intron_Mapped_plus %>%
  mutate_all(~ ifelse(. == "", "error", .))

Intron_Mapped_plus <- Intron_Mapped_plus %>%
  filter(rowSums(. == "error", na.rm = TRUE) == 0)



rownames(Intron_Mapped_plus) <- 1:nrow(Intron_Mapped_plus)


#Negative Stranded Introns
Intron_Mapped_minus[] <- lapply(Intron_Mapped_minus, function(x) gsub("[()<>]", "", x))
#UpsExon
Intron_Mapped_minus <- separate(Intron_Mapped_minus, scaled_values_UPS_EX, into = c("scaled_values_UPS_EX_ST", "scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN"), sep = ",", convert = TRUE)
Intron_Mapped_minus$scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN <- as.numeric(Intron_Mapped_minus$scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN)
#IntSt
Intron_Mapped_minus <- separate(Intron_Mapped_minus, scaled_values_IN_ST, into = c("scaled_values_IN_ST_ST", "scaled_values_IN_ST_EN"), sep = ",", convert = TRUE)
Intron_Mapped_minus$scaled_values_IN_ST_EN <- as.numeric(Intron_Mapped_minus$scaled_values_IN_ST_EN)
#IntEn
Intron_Mapped_minus <- separate(Intron_Mapped_minus, scaled_values_IN_EN, into = c("scaled_values_IN_EN_ST", "scaled_values_IN_EN_EN"), sep = ",", convert = TRUE)
Intron_Mapped_minus$scaled_values_IN_EN_EN <- as.numeric(Intron_Mapped_minus$scaled_values_IN_EN_EN)
#DowExon
Intron_Mapped_minus <- separate(Intron_Mapped_minus, scaled_values_DOW_EX, into = c("scaled_values_DOW_EX_ST", "scaled_values_DOW_EX_EN"), sep = ",", convert = TRUE)
Intron_Mapped_minus$scaled_values_DOW_EX_EN <- as.numeric(Intron_Mapped_minus$scaled_values_DOW_EX_EN)

Intron_Mapped_minus <- Intron_Mapped_minus %>%
  mutate_all(~ ifelse(. == "", "error", .))

Intron_Mapped_minus <- Intron_Mapped_minus %>%
  filter(rowSums(. == "error", na.rm = TRUE) == 0)



rownames(Intron_Mapped_minus) <- 1:nrow(Intron_Mapped_minus)

```


## Positive Stranded Introns

```{r}
#I figured it might be easier to do every region individually.

#UPSTREAM EXON REGION--------------------------------------------------
UPSEXR_plus <- Intron_Mapped_plus[,1:8]
UPSEXR_plus$length_UPS_EX <- as.numeric(UPSEXR_plus$length_UPS_EX)

UPSEXR_plus <- UPSEXR_plus %>%
  mutate(across(c("scaled_values_UPS_EX_ST", "scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN"), 
                ~ifelse(!is.na(.) & !is.na(scaled_values_UPS_EX_ST) & !is.na(scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN) & 
                          (scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN - scaled_values_UPS_EX_ST) <= 3, NA_real_, .)),
         length_UPS_EX = ifelse(!is.na(scaled_values_UPS_EX_ST) & !is.na(scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN) & 
                                (scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN - scaled_values_UPS_EX_ST) <= 3, NA_real_, length_UPS_EX))


UPSEXR_plus <- UPSEXR_plus %>%
  mutate(length_UPS_EX = if_else(is.na(scaled_values_UPS_EX_ST) | is.na(scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN),
                                 NA_real_, length_UPS_EX))

UPSEXR_plus_density <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(UPSEXR_plus), ncol = 50)

for (row in 1:nrow(UPSEXR_plus)) {
  if (!is.na(UPSEXR_plus[row, "length_UPS_EX"])) {
    start_col <- as.numeric(UPSEXR_plus[row, "scaled_values_UPS_EX_ST"])
    end_col <- as.numeric(UPSEXR_plus[row, "scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN"])
    
    # Check if start_col and end_col are valid numbers
    if (is.finite(start_col) && is.finite(end_col)) {
      UPSEXR_plus_density[row, seq(start_col, end_col)] <- 1
    } 
  }
}
colnames(UPSEXR_plus_density) <- paste0(1:50)


#---------------------------INTRON START REGION-----------------------
INTBEG_plus <- Intron_Mapped_plus[,c(1:4,9:12)]
INTBEG_plus$length_IN_ST <- as.numeric(INTBEG_plus$length_IN_ST)

INTBEG_plus <- INTBEG_plus %>%
  mutate(across(c("scaled_values_IN_ST_ST", "scaled_values_IN_ST_EN"), 
                ~ifelse(!is.na(.) & !is.na(scaled_values_IN_ST_ST) & !is.na(scaled_values_IN_ST_EN) & 
                          (scaled_values_IN_ST_EN - scaled_values_IN_ST_ST) <= 3, NA_real_, .)),
         length_IN_ST = ifelse(!is.na(scaled_values_IN_ST_ST) & !is.na(scaled_values_IN_ST_EN) & 
                                (scaled_values_IN_ST_EN - scaled_values_IN_ST_ST) <= 3, NA_real_, length_IN_ST))



INTBEG_plus <- INTBEG_plus %>%
  mutate(length_IN_ST = if_else(is.na(scaled_values_IN_ST_ST) | is.na(scaled_values_IN_ST_EN),
                                 NA_real_, length_IN_ST))




INTBEG_plus_density <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(INTBEG_plus), ncol = 200)


for (row in 1:nrow(INTBEG_plus)) {
  if (!is.na(INTBEG_plus[row, "length_IN_ST"])) {
    start_col <- as.numeric(INTBEG_plus[row, "scaled_values_IN_ST_ST"])
    end_col <- as.numeric(INTBEG_plus[row, "scaled_values_IN_ST_EN"])
    length_IN_ST <- INTBEG_plus[row, "length_IN_ST"]

    # Check if start_col and end_col are valid numbers
    if (is.finite(start_col) && is.finite(end_col)) {
      INTBEG_plus_density[row, seq(start_col, end_col)] <- 1
      if (length_IN_ST < 200) {
        # Adjust the condition for setting the range to NA
        end_col <- min(end_col, start_col + length_IN_ST - 1)
        
        # Set the relevant part of the row to NA using NA_real_
        INTBEG_plus_density[row, (length_IN_ST + 1):200] <- NA_real_
      } 
    }
  }
}
colnames(INTBEG_plus_density) <- paste0(51:250)



#---------------------------INTRON END REGION-----------------------
INTEND_plus <- Intron_Mapped_plus[,c(1:4,13:16)]
INTEND_plus$length_IN_EN <- as.numeric(INTEND_plus$length_IN_EN)


INTEND_plus <- INTEND_plus %>%
  mutate(across(c("scaled_values_IN_EN_ST", "scaled_values_IN_EN_EN"), 
                ~ifelse(!is.na(.) & !is.na(scaled_values_IN_EN_ST) & !is.na(scaled_values_IN_EN_EN) & 
                          (scaled_values_IN_EN_ST - scaled_values_IN_EN_EN) <= 3, NA_real_, .)),
         length_IN_EN = ifelse(!is.na(scaled_values_IN_EN_ST) & !is.na(scaled_values_IN_EN_EN) & 
                                (scaled_values_IN_EN_ST - scaled_values_IN_EN_EN) <= 3, NA_real_, length_IN_EN))


INTEND_plus <- INTEND_plus %>%
  mutate(length_IN_EN = if_else(is.na(scaled_values_IN_EN_ST) | is.na(scaled_values_IN_EN_EN),
                                 NA_real_, length_IN_EN))




INTEND_plus_density <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(INTEND_plus), ncol = 200)


for (row in 1:nrow(INTEND_plus)) {
  if (!is.na(INTEND_plus[row, "length_IN_EN"])) {
    start_col <- as.numeric(200 - INTEND_plus[row, "scaled_values_IN_EN_ST"])
    end_col <- as.numeric(201 - INTEND_plus[row, "scaled_values_IN_EN_EN"])
    length_IN_EN <- INTEND_plus[row, "length_IN_EN"]

    # Check if start_col and end_col are valid numbers
    if (is.finite(start_col) && is.finite(end_col)) {
      INTEND_plus_density[row, seq(start_col, end_col)] <- 1
      if (length_IN_EN < 200) {
        # Adjust the condition for setting the range to NA
        end_col <- min(end_col, start_col + length_IN_EN - 1)
        
        # Set the relevant part of the row to NA using NA_real_
        INTEND_plus_density[row, 0:(201-length_IN_EN)] <- NA_real_
      } 
    }
  }
}
colnames(INTEND_plus_density) <- paste0(251:450)

#--------------------------------------------------DOWNSTREAM EXON REGION
DOWEXR_plus <- Intron_Mapped_plus[,c(1:4,17:20)]
DOWEXR_plus$length_DOW_EX <- as.numeric(DOWEXR_plus$length_DOW_EX)


DOWEXR_plus <- DOWEXR_plus %>%
  mutate(across(c("scaled_values_DOW_EX_ST", "scaled_values_DOW_EX_EN"), 
                ~ifelse(!is.na(.) & !is.na(scaled_values_DOW_EX_ST) & !is.na(scaled_values_DOW_EX_EN) & 
                          (scaled_values_DOW_EX_EN - scaled_values_DOW_EX_ST) <= 3, NA_real_, .)),
         length_DOW_EX = ifelse(!is.na(scaled_values_DOW_EX_ST) & !is.na(scaled_values_DOW_EX_EN) & 
                                (scaled_values_DOW_EX_EN - scaled_values_DOW_EX_ST) <= 3, NA_real_, length_DOW_EX))



DOWEXR_plus <- DOWEXR_plus %>%
  mutate(length_DOW_EX = if_else(is.na(scaled_values_DOW_EX_ST) | is.na(scaled_values_DOW_EX_EN),
                                 NA_real_, length_DOW_EX))




DOWEXR_plus_density <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(DOWEXR_plus), ncol = 50)

for (row in 1:nrow(DOWEXR_plus)) {
  if (!is.na(DOWEXR_plus[row, "length_DOW_EX"])) {
    start_col <- as.numeric(DOWEXR_plus[row, "scaled_values_DOW_EX_ST"])
    end_col <- as.numeric(DOWEXR_plus[row, "scaled_values_DOW_EX_EN"])
    
    # Check if start_col and end_col are valid numbers
    if (is.finite(start_col) && is.finite(end_col)) {
      DOWEXR_plus_density[row, seq(start_col, end_col)] <- 1
    } 
  }
}
colnames(DOWEXR_plus_density) <- paste0(451:500)

###### NOW WE PUT ALL REGIONS TOGETHER
eCLIPSE_Intron_plus <- cbind(UPSEXR_plus_density, INTBEG_plus_density)
eCLIPSE_Intron_plus <- cbind(eCLIPSE_Intron_plus, INTEND_plus_density)
eCLIPSE_Intron_plus <- cbind(eCLIPSE_Intron_plus, DOWEXR_plus_density)

eCLIPSE_Intron_comp <- colSums(eCLIPSE_Intron_plus, na.rm = TRUE)
eCLIPSE_Intron_incomp <- colSums(is.na(eCLIPSE_Intron_plus))


df <- data.frame(
  Name = as.numeric(names(eCLIPSE_Intron_comp)),  # assuming the names are numeric
  Value1 = as.numeric(eCLIPSE_Intron_comp),
  Value2 = as.numeric(eCLIPSE_Intron_incomp)
)

# Create the line plot
ggplot(df, aes(x = Name)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Value1, color = "Vector1"), size = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Value2, color = "Vector2"), size = 1) + xlim(-50,550)+
  labs(title = "SG-RBPs IR Binding Peaks",
       x = "Density",
       y = "Position") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Vector1 = "blue", Vector2 = "red")) +
  theme_bw()+geom_vline(xintercept = c(50,250,450), linetype="dashed")
```

## Negative Stranded Introns

```{r}
#I figured it might be easier to do every region individually.
#SPECIAL ATTENTION IS NECESSARY AS EVERYTHING IS RESERVED ON THIS STRAND. UPSTREAM EXON IS ACTUALLY DOWNSTREAM AND VICE VERSA

#UPSTREAM EXON REGION--------------------------------------------------
UPSEXR_minus <- Intron_Mapped_minus[,c(1:4,17:20)]
UPSEXR_minus$length_DOW_EX <- as.numeric(UPSEXR_minus$length_DOW_EX)
#Reversing the coordinates:
#Saving OG Values
oldstart <- UPSEXR_minus$scaled_values_DOW_EX_ST
oldend <- UPSEXR_minus$scaled_values_DOW_EX_EN
UPSEXR_minus$scaled_values_DOW_EX_ST <- 50 - oldend
UPSEXR_minus$scaled_values_DOW_EX_EN <- 51 - oldstart


UPSEXR_minus <- UPSEXR_minus %>%
  mutate(across(c("scaled_values_DOW_EX_ST", "scaled_values_DOW_EX_EN"), 
                ~ifelse(!is.na(.) & !is.na(scaled_values_DOW_EX_ST) & !is.na(scaled_values_DOW_EX_EN) & 
                          (scaled_values_DOW_EX_EN - scaled_values_DOW_EX_ST) <= 3, NA_real_, .)),
         length_DOW_EX = ifelse(!is.na(scaled_values_DOW_EX_ST) & !is.na(scaled_values_DOW_EX_EN) & 
                                (scaled_values_DOW_EX_EN - scaled_values_DOW_EX_ST) <= 3, NA_real_, length_DOW_EX))


UPSEXR_minus <- UPSEXR_minus %>%
  mutate(length_DOW_EX = if_else(is.na(scaled_values_DOW_EX_ST) | is.na(scaled_values_DOW_EX_EN),
                                 NA_real_, length_DOW_EX))

UPSEXR_minus_density <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(UPSEXR_minus), ncol = 50)

for (row in 1:nrow(UPSEXR_minus)) {
  if (!is.na(UPSEXR_minus[row, "length_DOW_EX"])) {
    start_col <- as.numeric(UPSEXR_minus[row, "scaled_values_DOW_EX_ST"])

    # Check if start_col and end_col are valid numbers

      UPSEXR_minus_density[row, seq(start_col, end_col)] <- 1
    }

}

oldend <- DOWSEXR_minus$scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN

DOWSEXR_minus <- DOWSEXR_minus %>%
  mutate(across(c("scaled_values_UPS_EX_ST", "scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN"),

                                (scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN - scaled_values_UPS_EX_ST) <= 3, NA_real_, length_UPS_EX))


DOWSEXR_minus <- DOWSEXR_minus %>%
  mutate(length_DOW_EX = if_else(is.na(scaled_values_UPS_EX_ST) | is.na(scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN),
                                 NA_real_, length_UPS_EX))



DOWSEXR_minus_density <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(DOWSEXR_minus), ncol = 50)

for (row in 1:nrow(DOWSEXR_minus)) {
  if (!is.na(DOWSEXR_minus[row, "length_UPS_EX"])) {
    start_col <- as.numeric(DOWSEXR_minus[row, "scaled_values_UPS_EX_ST"])
    end_col <- as.numeric(DOWSEXR_minus[row, "scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN"])
    
    # Check if start_col and end_col are valid numbers
    if (is.finite(start_col) && is.finite(end_col)) {
      DOWSEXR_minus_density[row, seq(start_col, end_col)] <- 1
    } 
  }
}
colnames(DOWSEXR_minus_density) <- paste0(451:500)

###### NOW WE PUT ALL REGIONS TOGETHER
eCLIPSE_Intron_minus <- cbind(UPSEXR_minus_density, INTBEG_minus_density)
eCLIPSE_Intron_minus <- cbind(eCLIPSE_Intron_minus, INTEND_minus_density)
eCLIPSE_Intron_minus <- cbind(eCLIPSE_Intron_minus, DOWSEXR_minus_density)

eCLIPSE_Intron_comp <- colSums(eCLIPSE_Intron_minus, na.rm = TRUE)
eCLIPSE_Intron_incomp <- colSums(is.na(eCLIPSE_Intron_minus))


df <- data.frame(
  Name = as.numeric(names(eCLIPSE_Intron_comp)),  # assuming the names are numeric
  Value1 = as.numeric(eCLIPSE_Intron_comp),
  Value2 = as.numeric(eCLIPSE_Intron_incomp)
)

# Create the line plot
ggplot(df, aes(x = Name)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Value1, color = "Vector1"), size = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Value2, color = "Vector2"), size = 1) + xlim(-50,550)+
  labs(title = "SG-RBPs IR Binding Peaks",
       x = "Density",
       y = "Position") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Vector1 = "blue", Vector2 = "red")) +
  theme_bw()+geom_vline(xintercept = c(50,250,450), linetype="dashed")
```

## Function Based System

```{r}

eCLIPSE_IR <- function(rnamapfile, oddsrathreshold=0.5, pvalthreshold=0.05, PSIthreshold=0.05, ASfile, rnaBP, plot=FALSE, pdiffthreshold=0.8){
  rnamapfile_rbp <- subset(rnamapfile, RBP==rnaBP)
  hsevents <- rnamapfile_rbp$EVENTS
  
  ASfile <- subset(ASfile, Event.ID %in% hsevents)

  ASfile_filt_increased <- subset(ASfile, dPSI>PSIthreshold & Pdiff>pdiffthreshold)
  ASfile_filt_decreased <- subset(ASfile, dPSI< -PSIthreshold & Pdiff>pdiffthreshold)
  ASfile_filt_maintained <- subset(ASfile, !(dPSI > PSIthreshold & Pdiff > pdiffthreshold) & !(dPSI < -PSIthreshold & Pdiff > pdiffthreshold))

  #And now the eCLIPSE file
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased <- subset(rnamapfile_rbp, EVENTS %in% ASfile_filt_increased$Event.ID)
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained <- subset(rnamapfile_rbp, EVENTS %in% ASfile_filt_maintained$Event.ID)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased <- subset(rnamapfile_rbp, EVENTS %in% ASfile_filt_decreased$Event.ID)
  
  if (nrow(rnamapfile_rbp_increased) < 10 || 
      nrow(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained) < 10 || 
      nrow(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased) < 10) {
    print(paste0(rnaBP," does not have enough events."))
    return()  # Skip to the next iteration
  }
  
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased <- rnamapfile_rbp_increased[,-c(1001,1002)]
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased <- apply(rnamapfile_rbp_increased, c(1, 2), as.numeric)
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_comp <- colSums(rnamapfile_rbp_increased, na.rm = TRUE)
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_incomp <- colSums(!is.na(rnamapfile_rbp_increased))
  
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased <- rnamapfile_rbp_decreased[,-c(1001,1002)]
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased <- apply(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased, c(1, 2), as.numeric)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_comp <- colSums(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased, na.rm = TRUE)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_incomp <- colSums(!is.na(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased))
  
  
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained <- rnamapfile_rbp_maintained[,-c(1001,1002)]
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained <- apply(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained, c(1, 2), as.numeric)
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_comp <- colSums(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained, na.rm = TRUE)
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_incomp <- colSums(!is.na(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained))

  

  
  
  
  
  
  #PLOTTING
  dfforvis <- data.frame(
    Name = as.numeric(names(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_comp)),  # the names are the metagenomic coordinates
    IncreasedEvents = as.numeric(rnamapfile_rbp_increased_comp+1),
    DecreasedEvents = as.numeric(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_comp+1),
    MaintainedEvents = as.numeric(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_comp+1)
  )
  
  #pval calculations
  #pvals <- c()
  # for (i in 1:nrow(movingwindow)) {
  #   pvalue <- chisq.test(dfforvis[(movingwindow[i,1]:movingwindow[i,2]), -1])$p.value
  #   pvals <- c(pvals, pvalue)
  # }
  
  pval_inc <- c()
  pval_dec <- c()
  oddsratio_inc <- c()
  oddsratio_dec <- c()
  for (i in 1:1000){
    inc_fish <- dfforvis[i,2]
    inc_fish_rev <- (rnamapfile_rbp_increased_incomp[i] - dfforvis[i,2])
    inc_fish_vs <- (dfforvis[i,3]+dfforvis[i,4])
    inc_fish_vs_rev <- (rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_incomp[i]+rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_incomp[i])-(dfforvis[i,3]+dfforvis[i,4])
    
    dec_fish <- dfforvis[i,3]
    dec_fish_rev <- (rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_incomp[i] - dfforvis[i,3])
    dec_fish_vs <- (dfforvis[i,2]+dfforvis[i,4])
    dec_fish_vs_rev <- (rnamapfile_rbp_increased_incomp[i]+rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_incomp[i])-(dfforvis[i,2]+dfforvis[i,4])
    
    inc_df <- matrix(c(inc_fish, inc_fish_rev, inc_fish_vs, inc_fish_vs_rev), nrow = 2)
    inc_pval <- fisher.test(inc_df)$p.value
    inc_odds <- fisher.test(inc_df)$estimate
    
    dec_df <- matrix(c(dec_fish, dec_fish_rev, dec_fish_vs, dec_fish_vs_rev), nrow = 2)
    dec_pval <- fisher.test(dec_df)$p.value
    dec_odds <- fisher.test(dec_df)$estimate
    
    inc_pval <- -log10(p.adjust(inc_pval, method = "BH", n = 1000))
    dec_pval <- -log10(p.adjust(dec_pval, method = "BH", n = 1000))
    
    if ((inc_fish/rnamapfile_rbp_increased_incomp[i]) <=(inc_fish_vs/(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_incomp[i]+rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_incomp[i]))){
      inc_pval <- inc_pval*-1
    }
    if ((dec_fish/rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_incomp[i]) <=(dec_fish_vs/(rnamapfile_rbp_increased_incomp[i]+rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_incomp[i]))){
      dec_pval <- dec_pval*-1
    }
    pval_inc <- c(pval_inc,inc_pval)
    oddsratio_inc <- c(oddsratio_inc, inc_odds)
    pval_dec <- c(pval_dec,dec_pval)
    oddsratio_dec <- c(oddsratio_dec, dec_odds)
    
  }
  
  dfforvis_pval <- data.frame(pos=1:1000, pvalinc=pval_inc, pvaldec=pval_dec)
  dfforvis_oddsratio <- data.frame(pos=1:1000, oddsratinc=oddsratio_inc, oddsratdec=oddsratio_dec)
  
  #The dataframe must be modified beforehand
  dfforvis$IncreasedEvents <- dfforvis$IncreasedEvents/rnamapfile_rbp_increased_incomp
  dfforvis$DecreasedEvents <- dfforvis$DecreasedEvents/rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_incomp
  dfforvis$MaintainedEvents <- dfforvis$MaintainedEvents/rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_incomp
  
  if (plot==TRUE){
    
    mapplot <- ggplot(dfforvis, aes(x = Name)) +
      geom_line(aes(y = IncreasedEvents, color = "IncreasedEvents"), size = 1) + theme(text=element_text(family = "Quicksand"))+
      geom_line(aes(y = DecreasedEvents, color = "DecreasedEvents"), size = 1) +
      geom_line(aes(y = MaintainedEvents, color = "MaintainedEvents"), size = 1) + xlim(-50, 1050) +
      labs(title = paste0(rnaBP, " RNA Binding Map"),
           x = "Position",
           y = "Normalized Density") +
      scale_color_manual(values = c(IncreasedEvents = "#de425b", DecreasedEvents = "#769fca", MaintainedEvents = "black")) +
      theme_bw() +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(0,50, 250, 450,500,550,750,950,1000), linetype = "dashed") +
      geom_label(aes(x = 850, y = 0.185, fontface='bold', label = paste0("Increased: ", nrow(ASfile_filt_increased))),colour="#de425b",label.size=NA,face='bold')+
      geom_label(aes(x = 850, y = 0.15, fontface='bold', label = paste0("Maintained: ", nrow(ASfile_filt_maintained))),label.size=NA,face='bold')+
      geom_label(aes(x = 850, y = 0.115, fontface='bold', label.size=NA, label = paste0("Decreased: ", nrow(ASfile_filt_decreased))),colour="#769fca",label.size=NA,face='bold')+ 
      theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
        legend.position = "None")+theme(text=element_text(size=15,  family="Arial MS"))
  }
  
  if (plot==TRUE){
    pvalplot <- ggplot(dfforvis_pval, aes(x = pos)) +
      geom_line(aes(y = pvalinc, color = "Increased"), size = 1) + theme(text=element_text(family = "Quicksand"))+
      geom_line(aes(y = pvaldec, color = "Decreased"), size = 1) +
      xlim(-50, 1050) +
      labs(x = "Position",
           y = "-log10(P-Value)") +
      theme_bw() +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(0,50, 250, 450,500,550,750,950,1000), linetype = "dashed")+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Increased" = "#de425b", "Decreased" = "#769fca"))+ theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
        legend.position = "None")+theme(text=element_text(size=15,  family="Arial MS"))+
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.01)
  )
    
    completeplot <- ggarrange(mapplot,pvalplot, ncol=1)
  }
  
  if (any(abs(dfforvis_oddsratio$oddsratinc) > oddsrathreshold) || any(abs(dfforvis_oddsratio$oddsratdec) > oddsrathreshold)){
    print(completeplot)
  }

  else{
    print(paste0(rnaBP, " has no significance."))
    print(completeplot)
  }
}


eCLIPSE_full_IR <- function(rnamapfile, pvalthreshold=0.05, PSIthreshold=0.05, ASfile, rnaBP, metric = "FDR", plot = T, title = NULL){
  
  ASfile <- ASfile[grepl("HsaINT", Event.ID)]
  AS_events <- ASfile$Event.ID
 
  ASfile_filt_increased <- subset(ASfile, dPSI>PSIthreshold)
  ASfile_filt_decreased <- subset(ASfile, dPSI< -PSIthreshold)
  ASfile_filt_maintained <- subset(ASfile, !(dPSI > PSIthreshold) & !(dPSI < -PSIthreshold))

  #And now the eCLIPSE file
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased <- subset(rnamapfile, EVENTS %in% ASfile_filt_increased$Event.ID)
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained <- subset(rnamapfile, EVENTS %in% ASfile_filt_maintained$Event.ID)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased <- subset(rnamapfile, EVENTS %in% ASfile_filt_decreased$Event.ID)
  
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_rbp <- subset(rnamapfile_rbp_increased, RBP==rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp <- subset(rnamapfile_rbp_increased, RBP!=rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp <- rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp[!duplicated(rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp$EVENTS), ]
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp[rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp == 1] <- 0
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_rbp <- subset(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained, RBP==rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp <-subset(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained, RBP!=rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp <- rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp[!duplicated(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp$EVENTS), ]
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp[rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp == 1] <- 0
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_rbp <- subset(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased, RBP==rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp <- subset(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased, RBP!=rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp <- rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp[!duplicated(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp$EVENTS), ]
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp[rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp == 1] <- 0
  
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased <- rbind(rnamapfile_rbp_increased_rbp, rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased <- rbind(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_rbp, rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp)
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained <- rbind(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_rbp, rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp)
  
  if (nrow(rnamapfile_rbp_increased) < 10 || 
      nrow(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained) < 10 || 
      nrow(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased) < 10) {
    print(paste0(rnaBP," does not have enough events."))
    return()  # Skip to the next iteration
  }
  
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased <- rnamapfile_rbp_increased[,-c(501,502)]
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased <- apply(rnamapfile_rbp_increased, c(1, 2), as.numeric)
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_comp <- colSums(rnamapfile_rbp_increased, na.rm = TRUE)
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_incomp <- colSums(!is.na(rnamapfile_rbp_increased))
  
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased <- rnamapfile_rbp_decreased[,-c(501,502)]
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased <- apply(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased, c(1, 2), as.numeric)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_comp <- colSums(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased, na.rm = TRUE)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_incomp <- colSums(!is.na(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased))
  
  
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained <- rnamapfile_rbp_maintained[,-c(501,502)]
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained <- apply(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained, c(1, 2), as.numeric)
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_comp <- colSums(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained, na.rm = TRUE)
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_incomp <- colSums(!is.na(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained))

  #PLOTTING
  dfforvis <- data.frame(
    Name = as.numeric(names(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_comp)),  # the names are the metagenomic coordinates
    IncreasedEvents = as.numeric(rnamapfile_rbp_increased_comp+1),
    DecreasedEvents = as.numeric(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_comp+1),
    MaintainedEvents = as.numeric(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_comp+1)
  )
  
  
  pval_inc <- c()
  pval_dec <- c()
  oddsratio_inc <- c()
  oddsratio_dec <- c()
  for (i in 1:500){
    inc_fish <- dfforvis[i,2]
    inc_fish_rev <- (rnamapfile_rbp_increased_incomp[i] - dfforvis[i,2])
    inc_fish_vs <- (dfforvis[i,4])
    inc_fish_vs_rev <- (rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_incomp[i])-(dfforvis[i,4])
    
    dec_fish <- dfforvis[i,3]
    dec_fish_rev <- (rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_incomp[i] - dfforvis[i,3])
    dec_fish_vs <- (dfforvis[i,4])
    dec_fish_vs_rev <- (rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_incomp[i])-(dfforvis[i,4])
    
    inc_df <- matrix(c(inc_fish, inc_fish_rev, inc_fish_vs, inc_fish_vs_rev), nrow = 2)
    inc_pval <- chisq.test(inc_df)$p.value
    inc_odds <- chisq.test(inc_df)$statistic
    
    dec_df <- matrix(c(dec_fish, dec_fish_rev, dec_fish_vs, dec_fish_vs_rev), nrow = 2)
    dec_pval <- chisq.test(dec_df)$p.value
    dec_odds <- chisq.test(dec_df)$statistic
    
    inc_pval <- -log10(p.adjust(inc_pval, method = "BH", n = 500))
    dec_pval <- -log10(p.adjust(dec_pval, method = "BH", n = 500))
    
    if ((inc_fish/rnamapfile_rbp_increased_incomp[i]) <=(inc_fish_vs/(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_incomp[i]+rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_incomp[i]))){
      inc_pval <- inc_pval*-1
      inc_odds <- inc_odds*-1
    }
    if ((dec_fish/rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_incomp[i]) <=(dec_fish_vs/(rnamapfile_rbp_increased_incomp[i]+rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_incomp[i]))){
      dec_pval <- dec_pval*-1
      dec_odds <- dec_odds*-1
    }
    pval_inc <- c(pval_inc,inc_pval)
    oddsratio_inc <- c(oddsratio_inc, inc_odds)
    pval_dec <- c(pval_dec,dec_pval)
    oddsratio_dec <- c(oddsratio_dec, dec_odds)
    
  }
  
  dfforvis_pval <- data.frame(pos=1:500, pvalinc=pval_inc, pvaldec=pval_dec)
  dfforvis_oddsratio <- data.frame(pos=1:500, oddsratinc=oddsratio_inc, oddsratdec=oddsratio_dec)
  
  #The dataframe must be modified beforehand
  dfforvis$IncreasedEvents <- dfforvis$IncreasedEvents/rnamapfile_rbp_increased_incomp
  dfforvis$DecreasedEvents <- dfforvis$DecreasedEvents/rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_incomp
  dfforvis$MaintainedEvents <- dfforvis$MaintainedEvents/rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_incomp
  
  if (plot==TRUE){
    
    mapplot <- ggplot(dfforvis, aes(x = Name)) +
      geom_line(aes(y = IncreasedEvents, color = "IncreasedEvents"), size = 1) + 
      geom_line(aes(y = DecreasedEvents, color = "DecreasedEvents"), size = 1) +
      geom_line(aes(y = MaintainedEvents, color = "MaintainedEvents"), size = 1) + xlim(0, 500) +
      labs(title = paste0(rnaBP, " RNA Binding Map - ", title),
           x = "",
           y = "Normalized\nDensity\n") +
      scale_color_manual(values = c(IncreasedEvents = "#de425b", DecreasedEvents = "#769fca", MaintainedEvents = "black")) +
      theme_bw() +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(0,50, 250, 450,500), linetype = "dashed") +
      theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
        legend.position = "None")+theme(text=element_text(size=15))
    
    labels_plot <- ggplot() +
      annotate("text", x = 1, y = 0, label = paste0("Increased: ",length(table(rnamapfile_rbp_increased_rbp$EVENT)), " (", nrow(ASfile_filt_increased), ")\n"), 
               color = "#de425b", size = 4, fontface = "bold", hjust= -0.75) +
      annotate("text", x = 1, y = 0, label = paste0("Maintained: ",length(table(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_rbp$EVENT)), " (", nrow(ASfile_filt_maintained), ")\n"), 
               color = "black", size = 4, fontface = "bold",hjust=0.5) +
      annotate("text", x = 1, y = 0, label = paste0("Decreased: ",length(table(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_rbp$EVENT)), " (", nrow(ASfile_filt_decreased), ")\n"), 
               color = "#769fca", size = 4, fontface = "bold", hjust=1.75) +
      theme_void() + # Removes all axes and background
      theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0))
    
  }
  
if (plot==TRUE){
    if (metric=="EffectSize"){
      metricplot <- ggplot(dfforvis_oddsratio, aes(x = pos)) +
        geom_line(aes(y = oddsratinc, color = "Increased"), size = 1) + 
        geom_line(aes(y = oddsratdec, color = "Decreased"), size = 1) +
        xlim(0, 500) +
        labs(x = "Position",
             y = "Chi-Squared\nStatistic\n") +
        theme_bw() +
        geom_vline(xintercept = c(0, 50, 250, 450, 500), linetype = "dashed")+
        scale_color_manual(values = c("Increased" = "#de425b", "Decreased" = "#769fca"))+ theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
                                                                                                panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
                                                                                                panel.border = element_blank(),
                                                                                                panel.background = element_blank(),
                                                                                                axis.text.x=element_blank(),
                                                                                                axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
                                                                                                legend.position = "None")+theme(text=element_text(size=15))+
        scale_y_continuous(
          labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.01)
        )}
    if (metric=="FDR"){
      metricplot <- ggplot(dfforvis_pval, aes(x = pos)) +
        geom_line(aes(y = pvalinc, color = "Increased"), size = 1) + 
        geom_line(aes(y = pvaldec, color = "Decreased"), size = 1) +
        xlim(0, 500) +
        labs(x = "Position",
             y = "-log10 (FDR)\n") +
        theme_bw() +
        geom_vline(xintercept = c(0, 50, 250, 450, 500), linetype = "dashed")+
        scale_color_manual(values = c("Increased" = "#de425b", "Decreased" = "#769fca"))+ theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
                                                                                                panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
                                                                                                panel.border = element_blank(),
                                                                                                panel.background = element_blank(),
                                                                                                axis.text.x=element_blank(),
                                                                                                axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
                                                                                                legend.position = "None")+theme(text=element_text(size=15))+
        scale_y_continuous(
          labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.01)
        )}
    
    completeplot <- ggarrange(mapplot, labels_plot, metricplot, ncol=1, heights = c(0.4,0.1,0.4), align="v")
  }
  
  if (plot){
    return(completeplot)
  }
  else{
    return(list(pval_data = dfforvis_pval, oddsratio_data = dfforvis_oddsratio))
  }
}







eCLIPSE_heatmap_IR <- function(metric, rnamapfile, pvalthreshold=0.05, PSIthreshold=0.05, ASfile, rnaBP, plot=FALSE){
  
  ASfile <- ASfile[grepl("HsaINT", Event.ID)]


  AS_events <- ASfile$Event.ID
 
  ASfile_filt_increased <- subset(ASfile, dPSI>PSIthreshold)
  ASfile_filt_decreased <- subset(ASfile, dPSI< -PSIthreshold)
  ASfile_filt_maintained <- subset(ASfile, !(dPSI > PSIthreshold) & !(dPSI < -PSIthreshold))

  #And now the eCLIPSE file
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased <- subset(rnamapfile, EVENTS %in% ASfile_filt_increased$Event.ID)
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained <- subset(rnamapfile, EVENTS %in% ASfile_filt_maintained$Event.ID)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased <- subset(rnamapfile, EVENTS %in% ASfile_filt_decreased$Event.ID)
  
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_rbp <- subset(rnamapfile_rbp_increased, RBP==rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp <- subset(rnamapfile_rbp_increased, RBP!=rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp <- rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp[!duplicated(rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp$EVENTS), ]
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp[rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp == 1] <- 0
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_rbp <- subset(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained, RBP==rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp <-subset(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained, RBP!=rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp <- rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp[!duplicated(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp$EVENTS), ]
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp[rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp == 1] <- 0
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_rbp <- subset(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased, RBP==rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp <- subset(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased, RBP!=rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp <- rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp[!duplicated(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp$EVENTS), ]
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp[rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp == 1] <- 0
  
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased <- rbind(rnamapfile_rbp_increased_rbp, rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased <- rbind(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_rbp, rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp)
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained <- rbind(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_rbp, rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp)
  
  if (nrow(rnamapfile_rbp_increased) < 10 || 
      nrow(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained) < 10 || 
      nrow(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased) < 10) {
    print(paste0(rnaBP," does not have enough events."))
    return()  # Skip to the next iteration
  }
  
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased <- rnamapfile_rbp_increased[,-c(501,502)]
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased <- apply(rnamapfile_rbp_increased, c(1, 2), as.numeric)
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_comp <- colSums(rnamapfile_rbp_increased, na.rm = TRUE)
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_incomp <- colSums(!is.na(rnamapfile_rbp_increased))
  
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased <- rnamapfile_rbp_decreased[,-c(501,502)]
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased <- apply(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased, c(1, 2), as.numeric)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_comp <- colSums(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased, na.rm = TRUE)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_incomp <- colSums(!is.na(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased))
  
  
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained <- rnamapfile_rbp_maintained[,-c(501,502)]
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained <- apply(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained, c(1, 2), as.numeric)
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_comp <- colSums(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained, na.rm = TRUE)
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_incomp <- colSums(!is.na(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained))

  #PLOTTING
  dfforvis <- data.frame(
    Name = as.numeric(names(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_comp)),  # the names are the metagenomic coordinates
    IncreasedEvents = as.numeric(rnamapfile_rbp_increased_comp+1),
    DecreasedEvents = as.numeric(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_comp+1),
    MaintainedEvents = as.numeric(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_comp+1)
  )
  
  
  pval_inc <- c()
  pval_dec <- c()
  oddsratio_inc <- c()
  oddsratio_dec <- c()
  for (i in 1:500){
    inc_fish <- dfforvis[i,2]
    inc_fish_rev <- (rnamapfile_rbp_increased_incomp[i] - dfforvis[i,2])
    inc_fish_vs <- (dfforvis[i,4])
    inc_fish_vs_rev <- (+rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_incomp[i])-(dfforvis[i,4])
    
    dec_fish <- dfforvis[i,3]
    dec_fish_rev <- (rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_incomp[i] - dfforvis[i,3])
    dec_fish_vs <- (dfforvis[i,4])
    dec_fish_vs_rev <- (rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_incomp[i])-(dfforvis[i,4])
    
    inc_df <- matrix(c(inc_fish, inc_fish_rev, inc_fish_vs, inc_fish_vs_rev), nrow = 2)
    inc_pval <- chisq.test(inc_df)$p.value
    inc_odds <- chisq.test(inc_df)$statistic
    
    dec_df <- matrix(c(dec_fish, dec_fish_rev, dec_fish_vs, dec_fish_vs_rev), nrow = 2)
    dec_pval <- chisq.test(dec_df)$p.value
    dec_odds <- chisq.test(dec_df)$statistic
    
    inc_pval <- -log10(p.adjust(inc_pval, method = "BH", n = 500))
    dec_pval <- -log10(p.adjust(dec_pval, method = "BH", n = 500))
    
    if ((inc_fish/rnamapfile_rbp_increased_incomp[i]) <=(inc_fish_vs/(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_incomp[i]+rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_incomp[i]))){
      inc_pval <- inc_pval*-1
      inc_odds <- inc_odds*-1
    }
    if ((dec_fish/rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_incomp[i]) <=(dec_fish_vs/(rnamapfile_rbp_increased_incomp[i]+rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_incomp[i]))){
      dec_pval <- dec_pval*-1
      dec_odds <- dec_odds*-1
      
    }
    pval_inc <- c(pval_inc,inc_pval)
    oddsratio_inc <- c(oddsratio_inc, inc_odds)
    pval_dec <- c(pval_dec,dec_pval)
    oddsratio_dec <- c(oddsratio_dec, dec_odds)
    
  }
  
dfforvis_pval <- data.frame(pos = 1:500, pvalinc = pval_inc, pvaldec = pval_dec)
dfforvis_oddsratio <- data.frame(pos = 1:500, oddsratinc = oddsratio_inc, oddsratdec = oddsratio_dec)

# Return both data frames as a list, regardless of the 'metric'
return(list(pval_data = dfforvis_pval, oddsratio_data = dfforvis_oddsratio))
}
```

```{r}
#_______________________________________________________Positive Stranded Introns
BigExon_Mapped_plus[] <- lapply(BigExon_Mapped_plus, function(x) gsub("[()<>]", "", x))
```

## Positive Stranded Big Exons

```{r}
#I figured it might be easier to do every region individually.

#UPSTREAM EXON REGION--------------------------------------------------
UPSEXR_plus <- BigExon_Mapped_plus[,1:8]
UPSEXR_plus$length_UPS_EX <- as.numeric(UPSEXR_plus$length_UPS_EX)

UPSEXR_plus <- UPSEXR_plus %>%
  mutate(across(c("scaled_values_UPS_EX_ST", "scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN"),
                ~ifelse(!is.na(.) & !is.na(scaled_values_UPS_EX_ST) & !is.na(scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN) &
                          (scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN - scaled_values_UPS_EX_ST) < 0, NA_real_, .)),
         length_UPS_EX = ifelse(!is.na(scaled_values_UPS_EX_ST) & !is.na(scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN) &
                                (scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN - scaled_values_UPS_EX_ST) < 0, NA_real_, length_UPS_EX))


UPSEXR_plus <- UPSEXR_plus %>%
  mutate(length_UPS_EX = if_else(is.na(scaled_values_UPS_EX_ST) | is.na(scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN),
                                 NA_real_, length_UPS_EX))



UPSEXR_plus$scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN[UPSEXR_plus$scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN > 50] <- 50
UPSEXR_plus_density <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(UPSEXR_plus), ncol = 50)

for (row in 1:nrow(UPSEXR_plus)) {
  if (!is.na(UPSEXR_plus[row, "length_UPS_EX"])) {
    start_col <- as.numeric(UPSEXR_plus[row, "scaled_values_UPS_EX_ST"])
    end_col <- as.numeric(UPSEXR_plus[row, "scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN"])
    
    # Check if start_col and end_col are valid numbers
    if (is.finite(start_col) && is.finite(end_col)) {
      UPSEXR_plus_density[row, seq(start_col, end_col)] <- 1
    } 
  }
}

                                (scaled_values_UPS_IN_ST_EN - scaled_values_UPS_IN_ST_ST) < 0, NA_real_, length_UPS_IN_ST))

UPSINTBEG_plus$scaled_values_UPS_IN_ST_EN[UPSINTBEG_plus$scaled_values_UPS_IN_ST_EN > 200] <- 200

  if (!is.na(UPSINTBEG_plus[row, "length_UPS_IN_ST"])) {

    end_col <- as.numeric(UPSINTBEG_plus[row, "scaled_values_UPS_IN_ST_EN"])
    length_UPS_IN_ST <- UPSINTBEG_plus[row, "length_UPS_IN_ST"]

    # Check if start_col and end_col are valid numbers
    if (is.finite(start_col) && is.finite(end_col)) {
      UPSINTBEG_plus_density[row, seq(start_col, end_col)] <- 1
      if (length_UPS_IN_ST < 200) {
        # Adjust the condition for setting the range to NA
        end_col <- min(end_col, start_col + length_UPS_IN_ST - 1)
        
        # Set the relevant part of the row to NA using NA_real_
        UPSINTBEG_plus_density[row, (length_UPS_IN_ST + 1):200] <- NA_real_
      } 
    }
  }
}
```

## Function Based System

```{r, warning=FALSE}
get_pos_df <- function(min_window_size,window_size){
  
  df_pos <- NULL
  
  for (pos in c(1:1000)){
    
    if ((pos) <= (1 + window_size - 1) & (pos - 1) >= (min_window_size-1)){
      
      df_pos <- rbind(df_pos, c(1, pos))
      
    } 
    if (pos > (1 + window_size - 1)){
      
      df_pos <- rbind(df_pos, c(pos - window_size + 1,pos))
      
    } 
    
    if ((pos) > (1000 - window_size + 1) & (1000 - pos) >= (min_window_size-1)) {
      
      df_pos <- rbind(df_pos, c(pos, 1000))
      
    }
  }
  
  df_pos <- as.data.frame(df_pos)
  df_pos <- df_pos[order(df_pos[,1]),]
  row.names(df_pos) <- NULL
  colnames(df_pos) <- c("startcol","endcol")
  
  return(df_pos) 
  
}
eCLIPSE_full <- function(rnamapfile, pvalthreshold=0.05, PSIthreshold=0.05, ASfile, rnaBP, metric = "FDR", plot = T, title = NULL, ylim_metric = NULL){
  
  ASfile <- ASfile[grepl("HsaEX", Event.ID)]
  AS_events <- ASfile$Event.ID
 
  ASfile_filt_increased <- subset(ASfile, dPSI>PSIthreshold)
  ASfile_filt_decreased <- subset(ASfile, dPSI< -PSIthreshold)
  ASfile_filt_maintained <- subset(ASfile, !(dPSI > PSIthreshold) & !(dPSI < -PSIthreshold))

  #And now the eCLIPSE file
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased <- subset(rnamapfile, EVENTS %in% ASfile_filt_increased$Event.ID)
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained <- subset(rnamapfile, EVENTS %in% ASfile_filt_maintained$Event.ID)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased <- subset(rnamapfile, EVENTS %in% ASfile_filt_decreased$Event.ID)
  
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_rbp <- subset(rnamapfile_rbp_increased, RBP==rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp <- subset(rnamapfile_rbp_increased, RBP!=rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp <- rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp[!duplicated(rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp$EVENTS), ]
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp[rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp == 1] <- 0
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_rbp <- subset(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained, RBP==rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp <-subset(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained, RBP!=rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp <- rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp[!duplicated(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp$EVENTS), ]
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp[rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp == 1] <- 0
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_rbp <- subset(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased, RBP==rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp <- subset(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased, RBP!=rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp <- rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp[!duplicated(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp$EVENTS), ]
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp[rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp == 1] <- 0
  
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased <- rbind(rnamapfile_rbp_increased_rbp, rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased <- rbind(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_rbp, rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp)
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained <- rbind(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_rbp, rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp)
  
  if (nrow(rnamapfile_rbp_increased) < 10 || 
      nrow(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained) < 10 || 
      nrow(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased) < 10) {
    print(paste0(rnaBP," does not have enough events."))
    return()
  }
  
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased <- rnamapfile_rbp_increased[,-c(1001,1002)]
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased <- apply(rnamapfile_rbp_increased, c(1, 2), as.numeric)
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_comp <- colSums(rnamapfile_rbp_increased, na.rm = TRUE)
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_incomp <- colSums(!is.na(rnamapfile_rbp_increased))
  
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased <- rnamapfile_rbp_decreased[,-c(1001,1002)]
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased <- apply(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased, c(1, 2), as.numeric)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_comp <- colSums(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased, na.rm = TRUE)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_incomp <- colSums(!is.na(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased))
  
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained <- rnamapfile_rbp_maintained[,-c(1001,1002)]
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained <- apply(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained, c(1, 2), as.numeric)
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_comp <- colSums(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained, na.rm = TRUE)
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_incomp <- colSums(!is.na(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained))

  #PLOTTING
  dfforvis <- data.frame(
    Name = as.numeric(names(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_comp)),
    IncreasedEvents = as.numeric(rnamapfile_rbp_increased_comp+1),
    DecreasedEvents = as.numeric(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_comp+1),
    MaintainedEvents = as.numeric(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_comp+1)
  )
  
  pval_inc <- c()
  pval_dec <- c()
  oddsratio_inc <- c()
  oddsratio_dec <- c()
  for (i in 1:1000){
    inc_fish <- dfforvis[i,2]
    inc_fish_rev <- (rnamapfile_rbp_increased_incomp[i] - dfforvis[i,2])
    inc_fish_vs <- (dfforvis[i,4])
    inc_fish_vs_rev <- (rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_incomp[i])-(dfforvis[i,4])
    
    dec_fish <- dfforvis[i,3]
    dec_fish_rev <- (rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_incomp[i] - dfforvis[i,3])
    dec_fish_vs <- (dfforvis[i,4])
    dec_fish_vs_rev <- (rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_incomp[i])-(dfforvis[i,4])
    
    inc_df <- matrix(c(inc_fish, inc_fish_rev, inc_fish_vs, inc_fish_vs_rev), nrow = 2)
    inc_pval <- chisq.test(inc_df)$p.value
    inc_odds <- chisq.test(inc_df)$statistic
    
    dec_df <- matrix(c(dec_fish, dec_fish_rev, dec_fish_vs, dec_fish_vs_rev), nrow = 2)
    dec_pval <- chisq.test(dec_df)$p.value
    dec_odds <- chisq.test(dec_df)$statistic
    
    inc_pval <- -log10(p.adjust(inc_pval, method = "BH", n = 1000))
    dec_pval <- -log10(p.adjust(dec_pval, method = "BH", n = 1000))
    
    if ((inc_fish/rnamapfile_rbp_increased_incomp[i]) <=(inc_fish_vs/(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_incomp[i]))){
      inc_pval <- inc_pval*-1
      inc_odds <- inc_odds*-1
    }
    if ((dec_fish/rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_incomp[i]) <=(dec_fish_vs/(+rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_incomp[i]))){
      dec_pval <- dec_pval*-1
      dec_odds <- dec_odds*-1
    }
    pval_inc <- c(pval_inc,inc_pval)
    oddsratio_inc <- c(oddsratio_inc, inc_odds)
    pval_dec <- c(pval_dec,dec_pval)
    oddsratio_dec <- c(oddsratio_dec, dec_odds)
  }
  
  dfforvis_pval <- data.frame(pos=1:1000, pvalinc=pval_inc, pvaldec=pval_dec)
  dfforvis_oddsratio <- data.frame(pos=1:1000, oddsratinc=oddsratio_inc, oddsratdec=oddsratio_dec)
  
  dfforvis$IncreasedEvents <- dfforvis$IncreasedEvents/rnamapfile_rbp_increased_incomp
  dfforvis$DecreasedEvents <- dfforvis$DecreasedEvents/rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_incomp
  dfforvis$MaintainedEvents <- dfforvis$MaintainedEvents/rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_incomp
  
  if (plot==TRUE){
    
    mapplot <- ggplot(dfforvis, aes(x = Name)) +
      geom_line(aes(y = IncreasedEvents, color = "IncreasedEvents"), size = 1) +
      geom_line(aes(y = DecreasedEvents, color = "DecreasedEvents"), size = 1) +
      geom_line(aes(y = MaintainedEvents, color = "MaintainedEvents"), size = 1) + xlim(0, 1000) +
      labs(title = paste0(rnaBP, " RNA Binding Map - ", title),
           x = "",
           y = " Normalised\nDensity\n") +
      scale_color_manual(values = c(IncreasedEvents = "#de425b", DecreasedEvents = "#769fca", MaintainedEvents = "black")) +
      theme_bw() +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(0,50, 250, 450,500,550,750,950,1000), linetype = "dashed") +
      theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
        legend.position = "None") + theme(text=element_text(size=15))

    labels_plot <- ggplot() +
      annotate("text", x = 1, y = 0, label = paste0("Increased: ",length(unique(rnamapfile_rbp_increased_rbp$EVENT)), " (", nrow(ASfile_filt_increased), ")\n"), 
               color = "#de425b", size = 4.5, fontface = "bold", hjust= -0.75) +
      annotate("text", x = 1, y = 0, label = paste0("Maintained: ",length(unique(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_rbp$EVENT)), " (", nrow(ASfile_filt_maintained), ")\n"), 
               color = "black", size = 4.5, fontface = "bold",hjust=0.5) +
      annotate("text", x = 1, y = 0, label = paste0("Decreased: ",length(unique(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_rbp$EVENT)), " (", nrow(ASfile_filt_decreased), ")\n"), 
               color = "#769fca", size = 4.5, fontface = "bold", hjust=1.75) +
      theme_void() +
      theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0))
  }

  # ── Shared y-axis limit helper ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  # If ylim_metric is provided it must be a length-2 numeric vector, e.g. c(-5, 5)
  metric_ylim_layer <- if (!is.null(ylim_metric)) {
    coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim_metric)   # coord_cartesian clips without dropping data
  } else {
    NULL
  }

  if (plot==TRUE){
    if (metric == "EffectSize"){
      metricplot <- ggplot(dfforvis_oddsratio, aes(x = pos)) +
        geom_line(aes(y = oddsratinc, color = "Increased"), size = 1) +
        geom_line(aes(y = oddsratdec, color = "Decreased"), size = 1) +
        xlim(0, 1000) +
        labs(x = "Position",
             y = "Chi-Squared") +
        theme_bw() +
        geom_vline(xintercept = c(0,50, 250, 450,500,550,750,950,1000), linetype = "dashed") +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("Increased" = "#de425b", "Decreased" = "#769fca")) +
        theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
              panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
              panel.border = element_blank(),
              panel.background = element_blank(),
              axis.text.x=element_blank(),
              axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
              legend.position = "None") + theme(text=element_text(size=15)) +
        scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.01)) +
        metric_ylim_layer
    }
    if (metric == "FDR"){
      metricplot <- ggplot(dfforvis_pval, aes(x = pos)) +
        geom_line(aes(y = pvalinc, color = "Increased"), size = 1) +
        geom_line(aes(y = pvaldec, color = "Decreased"), size = 1) +
        xlim(0, 1000) +
        labs(x = "Position",
             y = "-log10 (FDR)\n") +
        theme_bw() +
        geom_vline(xintercept = c(0,50, 250, 450,500,550,750,950,1000), linetype = "dashed") +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("Increased" = "#de425b", "Decreased" = "#769fca")) +
        theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
              panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
              panel.border = element_blank(),
              panel.background = element_blank(),
              axis.text.x=element_blank(),
              axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
              legend.position = "None") + theme(text=element_text(size=15)) +
        scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.01)) +
        metric_ylim_layer
    }

    completeplot <- ggarrange(mapplot, labels_plot, metricplot, ncol=1, heights = c(0.4,0.1,0.4), align="v")
  }
  
  if (plot){
    return(completeplot)
  } else {
    return(list(pval_data = dfforvis_pval, oddsratio_data = dfforvis_oddsratio))
  }
}


eCLIPSE_full_MIC <- function(rnamapfile, pvalthreshold=0.05, PSIthreshold=0.05, ASfile, rnaBP, metric = "FDR", plot = T, title = NULL, mictypefile){
  
  ASfile <- mictypefile[grepl("HsaEX", EVENT)]
  AS_events <- mictypefile$EVENT
 
  ASfile_filt_increased <- subset(mictypefile, TIER=="HS")
  ASfile_filt_decreased <- subset(mictypefile, TIER=="LS")
  
  #And now the eCLIPSE file
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased <- subset(rnamapfile, EVENTS %in% ASfile_filt_increased$EVENT)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased <- subset(rnamapfile, EVENTS %in% ASfile_filt_decreased$EVENT)
  
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_rbp <- subset(rnamapfile_rbp_increased, RBP==rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp <- subset(rnamapfile_rbp_increased, RBP!=rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp <- rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp[!duplicated(rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp$EVENTS), ]
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp[rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp == 1] <- 0
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_rbp <- subset(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased, RBP==rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp <- subset(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased, RBP!=rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp <- rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp[!duplicated(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp$EVENTS), ]
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp[rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp == 1] <- 0
  
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased <- rbind(rnamapfile_rbp_increased_rbp, rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased <- rbind(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_rbp, rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp)
  
  if (nrow(rnamapfile_rbp_increased) < 10 || 
      nrow(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased) < 10) {
    print(paste0(rnaBP," does not have enough events."))
    return()  # Skip to the next iteration
  }
  
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased <- rnamapfile_rbp_increased[,-c(1001,1002)]
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased <- apply(rnamapfile_rbp_increased, c(1, 2), as.numeric)
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_comp <- colSums(rnamapfile_rbp_increased, na.rm = TRUE)
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_incomp <- colSums(!is.na(rnamapfile_rbp_increased))
  
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased <- rnamapfile_rbp_decreased[,-c(1001,1002)]
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased <- apply(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased, c(1, 2), as.numeric)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_comp <- colSums(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased, na.rm = TRUE)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_incomp <- colSums(!is.na(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased))
  

  #PLOTTING
  dfforvis <- data.frame(
    Name = as.numeric(names(rnamapfile_rbp_increased_comp)),  # the names are the metagenomic coordinates
    IncreasedEvents = as.numeric(rnamapfile_rbp_increased_comp+1),
    DecreasedEvents = as.numeric(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_comp+1)
  )
  
  
  pval_inc <- c()
  pval_dec <- c()
  oddsratio_inc <- c()
  oddsratio_dec <- c()
  for (i in 1:1000){
    inc_fish <- dfforvis[i,2]
    inc_fish_rev <- (rnamapfile_rbp_increased_incomp[i] - dfforvis[i,2])
    inc_fish_vs <- (dfforvis[i,3])
    inc_fish_vs_rev <- (rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_incomp[i])-(dfforvis[i,3])
    
    dec_fish <- dfforvis[i,3]
    dec_fish_rev <- (rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_incomp[i] - dfforvis[i,3])
    dec_fish_vs <- (dfforvis[i,2])
    dec_fish_vs_rev <- (rnamapfile_rbp_increased_incomp[i])-(dfforvis[i,2])
    
    inc_df <- matrix(c(inc_fish, inc_fish_rev, inc_fish_vs, inc_fish_vs_rev), nrow = 2)
    inc_pval <- chisq.test(inc_df)$p.value
    inc_odds <- chisq.test(inc_df)$statistic
    
    dec_df <- matrix(c(dec_fish, dec_fish_rev, dec_fish_vs, dec_fish_vs_rev), nrow = 2)
    dec_pval <- chisq.test(dec_df)$p.value
    dec_odds <- chisq.test(dec_df)$statistic
    
    inc_pval <- -log10(p.adjust(inc_pval, method = "BH", n = 1000))
    dec_pval <- -log10(p.adjust(dec_pval, method = "BH", n = 1000))
    
    if ((inc_fish/rnamapfile_rbp_increased_incomp[i]) <=(inc_fish_vs/(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_incomp[i]))){
      inc_pval <- inc_pval*-1
      inc_odds <- inc_odds*-1
    }
    if ((dec_fish/rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_incomp[i]) <=(dec_fish_vs/(+rnamapfile_rbp_increased_incomp[i]))){
      dec_pval <- dec_pval*-1
      dec_odds <- dec_odds*-1
    }
    pval_inc <- c(pval_inc,inc_pval)
    oddsratio_inc <- c(oddsratio_inc, inc_odds)
    pval_dec <- c(pval_dec,dec_pval)
    oddsratio_dec <- c(oddsratio_dec, dec_odds)
    
  }
  
  dfforvis_pval <- data.frame(pos=1:1000, pvalinc=pval_inc, pvaldec=pval_dec)
  dfforvis_oddsratio <- data.frame(pos=1:1000, oddsratinc=oddsratio_inc, oddsratdec=oddsratio_dec)
  
  #The dataframe must be modified beforehand
  dfforvis$IncreasedEvents <- dfforvis$IncreasedEvents/rnamapfile_rbp_increased_incomp
  dfforvis$DecreasedEvents <- dfforvis$DecreasedEvents/rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_incomp
  
  if (plot==TRUE){
    
mapplot <- ggplot(dfforvis, aes(x = Name)) +
      geom_line(aes(y = IncreasedEvents, color = "IncreasedEvents"), size = 1) +
      geom_line(aes(y = DecreasedEvents, color = "DecreasedEvents"), size = 1)  + xlim(0, 1000) +
      labs(title = paste0(rnaBP, " RNA Binding Map - ", title),
           x = "",
           y = " Normalised\nDensity\n") +
      scale_color_manual(values = c(IncreasedEvents = "#de425b", DecreasedEvents = "#769fca", MaintainedEvents = "black")) +
      theme_bw() +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(0,50, 250, 450,500,550,750,950,1000), linetype = "dashed") +
      theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
        legend.position = "None")+theme(text=element_text(size=15))

    labels_plot <- ggplot() +
  annotate("text", x = 1, y = 0, label = paste0("HS: ",length(table(rnamapfile_rbp_increased_rbp$EVENT)), " (", nrow(ASfile_filt_increased), ")\n"), 
           color = "#de425b", size = 4.5, fontface = "bold", hjust= -0.75) +
  annotate("text", x = 1, y = 0, label = paste0("LS: ",length(table(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_rbp$EVENT)), " (", nrow(ASfile_filt_decreased), ")\n"), 
           color = "#769fca", size = 4.5, fontface = "bold", hjust=1.75) +
  theme_void() + # Removes all axes and background
  theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0))
    
  }
  
  if (plot==TRUE){
    if (metric=="EffectSize"){
    metricplot <- ggplot(dfforvis_oddsratio, aes(x = pos)) +
      geom_line(aes(y = oddsratinc, color = "Increased"), size = 1) +
      geom_line(aes(y = oddsratdec, color = "Decreased"), size = 1) +
      xlim(0, 1000) +
      labs(x = "Position",
           y = "Chi-Squared\nStatistic\n") +
      theme_bw() +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(0,50, 250, 450,500,550,750,950,1000), linetype = "dashed")+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Increased" = "#de425b", "Decreased" = "#769fca"))+ theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
        legend.position = "None")+theme(text=element_text(size=15))+
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.01)
  )}
    if (metric=="FDR"){
    metricplot <- ggplot(dfforvis_pval, aes(x = pos)) +
      geom_line(aes(y = pvalinc, color = "Increased"), size = 1) +
      geom_line(aes(y = pvaldec, color = "Decreased"), size = 1) +
      xlim(0, 1000) +
      labs(x = "Position",
           y = "-log10 (FDR)\n") +
      theme_bw() +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(0,50, 250, 450,500,550,750,950,1000), linetype = "dashed")+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Increased" = "#de425b", "Decreased" = "#769fca"))+ theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
        legend.position = "None")+theme(text=element_text(size=15))+
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.01)
  )}
    
    completeplot <- ggarrange(mapplot, labels_plot, metricplot, ncol=1, heights = c(0.4,0.1,0.4), align="v")
  }
  
  if (plot){
    return(completeplot)
  }
  else{
    return(list(pval_data = dfforvis_pval, oddsratio_data = dfforvis_oddsratio))
  }
}
```

```{r}

eCLIPSE_heatmap <- function(metric, rnamapfile, pvalthreshold=0.05, PSIthreshold=0.05, ASfile, rnaBP, plot=FALSE){
  
  ASfile <- ASfile[grepl("HsaEX", Event.ID)]
  
  AS_events <- ASfile$Event.ID
 
  ASfile_filt_increased <- subset(ASfile, dPSI>PSIthreshold)
  ASfile_filt_decreased <- subset(ASfile, dPSI< -PSIthreshold)
  ASfile_filt_maintained <- subset(ASfile, !(dPSI > PSIthreshold) & !(dPSI < -PSIthreshold))

  #And now the eCLIPSE file
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased <- subset(rnamapfile, EVENTS %in% ASfile_filt_increased$Event.ID)
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained <- subset(rnamapfile, EVENTS %in% ASfile_filt_maintained$Event.ID)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased <- subset(rnamapfile, EVENTS %in% ASfile_filt_decreased$Event.ID)
  
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_rbp <- subset(rnamapfile_rbp_increased, RBP==rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp <- subset(rnamapfile_rbp_increased, RBP!=rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp <- rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp[!duplicated(rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp$EVENTS), ]
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp[rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp == 1] <- 0
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_rbp <- subset(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained, RBP==rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp <-subset(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained, RBP!=rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp <- rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp[!duplicated(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp$EVENTS), ]
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp[rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp == 1] <- 0
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_rbp <- subset(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased, RBP==rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp <- subset(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased, RBP!=rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp <- rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp[!duplicated(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp$EVENTS), ]
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp[rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp == 1] <- 0
  
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased <- rbind(rnamapfile_rbp_increased_rbp, rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased <- rbind(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_rbp, rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp)
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained <- rbind(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_rbp, rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp)
  
  if (nrow(rnamapfile_rbp_increased) < 10 || 
      nrow(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained) < 10 || 
      nrow(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased) < 10) {
    print(paste0(rnaBP," does not have enough events."))
    return()  # Skip to the next iteration
  }
  
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased <- rnamapfile_rbp_increased[,-c(1001,1002)]
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased <- apply(rnamapfile_rbp_increased, c(1, 2), as.numeric)
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_comp <- colSums(rnamapfile_rbp_increased, na.rm = TRUE)
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_incomp <- colSums(!is.na(rnamapfile_rbp_increased))
  
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased <- rnamapfile_rbp_decreased[,-c(1001,1002)]
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased <- apply(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased, c(1, 2), as.numeric)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_comp <- colSums(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased, na.rm = TRUE)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_incomp <- colSums(!is.na(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased))
  
  
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained <- rnamapfile_rbp_maintained[,-c(1001,1002)]
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained <- apply(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained, c(1, 2), as.numeric)
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_comp <- colSums(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained, na.rm = TRUE)
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_incomp <- colSums(!is.na(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained))

  #PLOTTING
  dfforvis <- data.frame(
    Name = as.numeric(names(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_comp)),  # the names are the metagenomic coordinates
    IncreasedEvents = as.numeric(rnamapfile_rbp_increased_comp+1),
    DecreasedEvents = as.numeric(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_comp+1),
    MaintainedEvents = as.numeric(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_comp+1)
  )
  
  
  pval_inc <- c()
  pval_dec <- c()
  oddsratio_inc <- c()
  oddsratio_dec <- c()
  for (i in 1:1000){
    inc_fish <- dfforvis[i,2]
    inc_fish_rev <- (rnamapfile_rbp_increased_incomp[i] - dfforvis[i,2])
    inc_fish_vs <- (dfforvis[i,4])
    inc_fish_vs_rev <- (rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_incomp[i])-(dfforvis[i,4])
    
    dec_fish <- dfforvis[i,3]
    dec_fish_rev <- (rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_incomp[i] - dfforvis[i,3])
    dec_fish_vs <- (dfforvis[i,2]+dfforvis[i,4])
    dec_fish_vs_rev <- (rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_incomp[i])-(dfforvis[i,4])
    
    inc_df <- matrix(c(inc_fish, inc_fish_rev, inc_fish_vs, inc_fish_vs_rev), nrow = 2)
    inc_pval <- chisq.test(inc_df)$p.value
    inc_odds <- chisq.test(inc_df)$statistic
    
    dec_df <- matrix(c(dec_fish, dec_fish_rev, dec_fish_vs, dec_fish_vs_rev), nrow = 2)
    dec_pval <- chisq.test(dec_df)$p.value
    dec_odds <- chisq.test(dec_df)$statistic
    
    inc_pval <- -log10(p.adjust(inc_pval, method = "BH", n = 1000))
    dec_pval <- -log10(p.adjust(dec_pval, method = "BH", n = 1000))
    
    if ((inc_fish/rnamapfile_rbp_increased_incomp[i]) <=(inc_fish_vs/(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_incomp[i]))){
      inc_pval <- inc_pval*-1
      inc_odds <- inc_odds*-1
    }
    if ((dec_fish/rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_incomp[i]) <=(dec_fish_vs/(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_incomp[i]))){
      dec_pval <- dec_pval*-1
      dec_odds <- dec_odds*-1
    }
    pval_inc <- c(pval_inc,inc_pval)
    oddsratio_inc <- c(oddsratio_inc, inc_odds)
    pval_dec <- c(pval_dec,dec_pval)
    oddsratio_dec <- c(oddsratio_dec, dec_odds)
    
  }
  
dfforvis_pval <- data.frame(pos = 1:1000, pvalinc = pval_inc, pvaldec = pval_dec)
dfforvis_oddsratio <- data.frame(pos = 1:1000, oddsratinc = oddsratio_inc, oddsratdec = oddsratio_dec)

# Return both data frames as a list, regardless of the 'metric'
return(list(pval_data = dfforvis_pval, oddsratio_data = dfforvis_oddsratio))
}


eCLIPSE_heatmap_MIC <- function(metric, rnamapfile, pvalthreshold=0.05, PSIthreshold=0.05, ASfile, rnaBP, plot=FALSE){
  
  rnamapfile <- rnamapfile[grepl("HsaEX", EVENTS),]
  
  AS_events <- ASfile$EVENT
 
  ASfile_filt_increased <- subset(ASfile, TIER=="HS")
  ASfile_filt_decreased <- subset(ASfile, TIER=="LS")
  #ASfile_filt_maintained <- subset(ASfile, !(dPSI > PSIthreshold) & !(dPSI < -PSIthreshold))

  #And now the eCLIPSE file
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased <- as.data.frame(subset(rnamapfile, EVENTS %in% ASfile_filt_increased$EVENT))
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased <- as.data.frame(subset(rnamapfile, EVENTS %in% ASfile_filt_decreased$EVENT))
  increased_and_decreased <- union(ASfile_filt_increased$EVENT, ASfile_filt_decreased$EVENT)
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained <- as.data.frame(subset(rnamapfile, !(EVENTS %in% increased_and_decreased)))

  
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_rbp <- subset(rnamapfile_rbp_increased, RBP==rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp <- subset(rnamapfile_rbp_increased, RBP!=rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp <- rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp[!duplicated(rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp$EVENTS), ]
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp[rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp == 1] <- 0
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_rbp <- subset(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained, RBP==rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp <-subset(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained, RBP!=rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp <- rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp[!duplicated(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp$EVENTS), ]
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp[rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp == 1] <- 0
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_rbp <- subset(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased, RBP==rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp <- subset(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased, RBP!=rnaBP)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp <- rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp[!duplicated(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp$EVENTS), ]
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp[rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp == 1] <- 0
  
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased <- rbind(rnamapfile_rbp_increased_rbp, rnamapfile_rbp_increased_nrbp)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased <- rbind(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_rbp, rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_nrbp)
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained <- rbind(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_rbp, rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_nrbp)
  
  if (nrow(rnamapfile_rbp_increased) < 10 || 
      nrow(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained) < 10 || 
      nrow(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased) < 10) {
    print(paste0(rnaBP," does not have enough events."))
    return()  # Skip to the next iteration
  }
  
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased <- rnamapfile_rbp_increased[,-c(1001,1002)]
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased <- apply(rnamapfile_rbp_increased, c(1, 2), as.numeric)
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_comp <- colSums(rnamapfile_rbp_increased, na.rm = TRUE)
  rnamapfile_rbp_increased_incomp <- colSums(!is.na(rnamapfile_rbp_increased))
  
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased <- rnamapfile_rbp_decreased[,-c(1001,1002)]
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased <- apply(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased, c(1, 2), as.numeric)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_comp <- colSums(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased, na.rm = TRUE)
  rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_incomp <- colSums(!is.na(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased))
  
  
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained <- rnamapfile_rbp_maintained[,-c(1001,1002)]
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained <- apply(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained, c(1, 2), as.numeric)
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_comp <- colSums(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained, na.rm = TRUE)
  rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_incomp <- colSums(!is.na(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained))

  #PLOTTING
  dfforvis <- data.frame(
    Name = as.numeric(names(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_comp)),  # the names are the metagenomic coordinates
    IncreasedEvents = as.numeric(rnamapfile_rbp_increased_comp+1),
    DecreasedEvents = as.numeric(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_comp+1),
    MaintainedEvents = as.numeric(rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_comp+1)
  )
  
  
  pval_inc <- c()
  pval_dec <- c()
  oddsratio_inc <- c()
  oddsratio_dec <- c()
  for (i in 1:1000){
    inc_fish <- dfforvis[i,2]
    inc_fish_rev <- (rnamapfile_rbp_increased_incomp[i] - dfforvis[i,2])
    inc_fish_vs <- (dfforvis[i,3]+dfforvis[i,4])
    inc_fish_vs_rev <- (rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_incomp[i]+rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_incomp[i])-(dfforvis[i,3]+dfforvis[i,4])
    
    dec_fish <- dfforvis[i,3]
    dec_fish_rev <- (rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_incomp[i] - dfforvis[i,3])
    dec_fish_vs <- (dfforvis[i,2]+dfforvis[i,4])
    dec_fish_vs_rev <- (rnamapfile_rbp_increased_incomp[i]+rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_incomp[i])-(dfforvis[i,2]+dfforvis[i,4])
    
    inc_df <- matrix(c(inc_fish, inc_fish_rev, inc_fish_vs, inc_fish_vs_rev), nrow = 2)
    inc_pval <- chisq.test(inc_df)$p.value
    inc_odds <- chisq.test(inc_df)$statistic
    
    dec_df <- matrix(c(dec_fish, dec_fish_rev, dec_fish_vs, dec_fish_vs_rev), nrow = 2)
    dec_pval <- chisq.test(dec_df)$p.value
    dec_odds <- chisq.test(dec_df)$statistic
    
    inc_pval <- -log10(p.adjust(inc_pval, method = "BH", n = 1000))
    dec_pval <- -log10(p.adjust(dec_pval, method = "BH", n = 1000))
    
    if ((inc_fish/rnamapfile_rbp_increased_incomp[i]) <=(inc_fish_vs/(rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_incomp[i]+rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_incomp[i]))){
      inc_pval <- inc_pval*-1
    }
    if ((dec_fish/rnamapfile_rbp_decreased_incomp[i]) <=(dec_fish_vs/(rnamapfile_rbp_increased_incomp[i]+rnamapfile_rbp_maintained_incomp[i]))){
      dec_pval <- dec_pval*-1
    }
    pval_inc <- c(pval_inc,inc_pval)
    oddsratio_inc <- c(oddsratio_inc, inc_odds)
    pval_dec <- c(pval_dec,dec_pval)
    oddsratio_dec <- c(oddsratio_dec, dec_odds)
    
  }
  
dfforvis_pval <- data.frame(pos = 1:1000, pvalinc = pval_inc, pvaldec = pval_dec)
dfforvis_oddsratio <- data.frame(pos = 1:1000, oddsratinc = oddsratio_inc, oddsratdec = oddsratio_dec)

# Return both data frames as a list, regardless of the 'metric'
return(list(pval_data = dfforvis_pval, oddsratio_data = dfforvis_oddsratio))
}
```

# Similarity Calculations

```{r}

shrna <- YBX3$YBX3$oddsratio_data$oddsratinc
wsg <- SG$YBX3$oddsratio_data$oddsratinc
wosg <- NoSG$YBX3$oddsratio_data$oddsratinc
library(transport)
library(kSamples)

similarity <- wasserstein1d(shrna, wsg)
print(similarity)
similarity <- wasserstein1d(wsg, wosg)
print(similarity)

cor.test(shrna, wsg, method = "pearson")
cor.test(wsg, wosg, method = "pearson")
cor.test(shrna, wsg, method = "spearman")
cor.test(wsg, wosg, method = "spearman")
wilcox.test(shrna, wsg, paired = TRUE)
wilcox.test(wsg, wosg, paired = TRUE)
# Compute AUC by trapezoidal rule
library(pracma)

auc_shrna <- trapz(1:length(shrna), shrna)
auc_wsg   <- trapz(1:length(wosg), wosg)

auc_values <- c(shrna = auc_shrna, withSG = auc_wsg)
print(auc_values)

# Pairwise comparisons via permutation test
perm_test <- function(x, y, nperm=10000) {
  obs <- abs(trapz(1:length(x), x) - trapz(1:length(y), y))
  combined <- c(x, y)
  diffs <- replicate(nperm, {
    idx <- sample(length(combined), length(x))
    abs(trapz(1:length(x), combined[idx]) - 
        trapz(1:length(y), combined[-idx]))
  })
  mean(diffs >= obs)
}

perm_test(shrna, wsg)
perm_test(shrna, TIA1_wosg)
perm_test(wsg, TIA1_wosg)
```

## Positive Stranded Big Exons

```{r}
#I figured it might be easier to do every region individually.

#UPSTREAM EXON REGION--------------------------------------------------
UPSEXR_plus <- BigExon_Mapped_plus[,1:8]
UPSEXR_plus$length_UPS_EX <- as.numeric(UPSEXR_plus$length_UPS_EX)

UPSEXR_plus <- UPSEXR_plus %>%
  mutate(across(c("scaled_values_UPS_EX_ST", "scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN"), 
                ~ifelse(!is.na(.) & !is.na(scaled_values_UPS_EX_ST) & !is.na(scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN) & 
                          (scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN - scaled_values_UPS_EX_ST) <= 3, NA_real_, .)),
         length_UPS_EX = ifelse(!is.na(scaled_values_UPS_EX_ST) & !is.na(scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN) & 
                                (scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN - scaled_values_UPS_EX_ST) <= 3, NA_real_, length_UPS_EX))


UPSEXR_plus <- UPSEXR_plus %>%
  mutate(length_UPS_EX = if_else(is.na(scaled_values_UPS_EX_ST) | is.na(scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN),
                                 NA_real_, length_UPS_EX))




UPSEXR_plus_density <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(UPSEXR_plus), ncol = 50)

for (row in 1:nrow(UPSEXR_plus)) {
  if (!is.na(UPSEXR_plus[row, "length_UPS_EX"])) {
    start_col <- as.numeric(50 - UPSEXR_plus[row, "scaled_values_UPS_EX_ST"])
    end_col <- as.numeric(51 - UPSEXR_plus[row, "scaled_values_UPS_EX_EN"])
    length_UPS_EX <- UPSEXR_plus[row, "length_UPS_EX"]
    
    # Check if start_col and end_col are valid numbers
    if (is.finite(start_col) && is.finite(end_col)) {
      UPSEXR_plus_density[row, seq(start_col, end_col)] <- 1
      if (length_UPS_EX < 50){
        end_col <- min(end_col, start_col + length_UPS_EX -1)
        UPSEXR_plus_density[row, 0:(51-length_UPS_EX)] <- NA_real_
      }
    } 
  }
}

eCLIPSE_BigExon_plus <- cbind(eCLIPSE_BigExon_plus, DOWINTEND_plus_density)
eCLIPSE_BigExon_plus <- cbind(eCLIPSE_BigExon_plus, DOWEXR_plus_density)


eCLIPSE_BigExon_comp <- colSums(eCLIPSE_BigExon_plus, na.rm = TRUE)
eCLIPSE_BigExon_incomp <- colSums(is.na(eCLIPSE_BigExon_plus))


df <- data.frame(
  Name = as.numeric(names(eCLIPSE_BigExon_comp)),  # assuming the names are numeric
  Value1 = as.numeric(eCLIPSE_BigExon_comp),
  Value2 = as.numeric(eCLIPSE_BigExon_incomp)
)

# Create the line plot
ggplot(df, aes(x = Name)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Value1, color = "Vector1"), size = 1) + geom_line(aes(y = Value2, color = "Vector2"), size = 1)  + xlim(-50,1050)+
  labs(title = "SG-RBPs AE Big Binding Peaks",
       x = "Density",
       y = "Position") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Vector1 = "blue", Vector2 = "red")) +
  theme_bw()+geom_vline(xintercept = c(0,50,250,450, 500, 550, 750, 950, 1000), linetype="dashed")
```

```{r}
#UPSTREAM EXON REGION--------------------------------------------------
UPSEXR_minus <- BigExon_Mapped_minus[,c(1:4,33:36)]
UPSEXR_minus$length_DOW_EX <- as.numeric(UPSEXR_minus$length_DOW_EX)
#Reversing the coordinates:
#Saving OG Valuese]¨¨
oldstart <- UPSEXR_minus$scaled_values_DOW_EX_ST
oldend <- UPSEXR_minus$scaled_values_DOW_EX_EN
UPSEXR_minus$scaled_values_DOW_EX_ST <- oldend
UPSEXR_minus$scaled_values_DOW_EX_EN <- oldstart


UPSEXR_minus <- UPSEXR_minus %>%
  mutate(across(c("scaled_values_DOW_EX_ST", "scaled_values_DOW_EX_EN"), 
                ~ifelse(!is.na(.) & !is.na(scaled_values_DOW_EX_ST) & !is.na(scaled_values_DOW_EX_EN) & 
                          (scaled_values_DOW_EX_ST - scaled_values_DOW_EX_EN) <= 3, NA_real_, .)),
         length_DOW_EX = ifelse(!is.na(scaled_values_DOW_EX_ST) & !is.na(scaled_values_DOW_EX_EN) & 
                                (scaled_values_DOW_EX_ST - scaled_values_DOW_EX_EN) <= 3, NA_real_, length_DOW_EX))


UPSEXR_minus <- UPSEXR_minus %>%
  mutate(length_DOW_EX = if_else(is.na(scaled_values_DOW_EX_ST) | is.na(scaled_values_DOW_EX_EN),
                                 NA_real_, length_DOW_EX))

UPSEXR_minus_density <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(UPSEXR_minus), ncol = 50)

for (row in 1:nrow(UPSEXR_minus)) {
  if (!is.na(UPSEXR_minus[row, "length_DOW_EX"])) {
    start_col <- as.numeric(50-UPSEXR_minus[row, "scaled_values_DOW_EX_ST"])
    end_col <- as.numeric(51-UPSEXR_minus[row, "scaled_values_DOW_EX_EN"])
    length_DOW_EX <- UPSEXR_minus[row, "length_DOW_EX"]
    
    # Check if start_col and end_col are valid numbers
    if (is.finite(start_col) && is.finite(end_col)) {
      UPSEXR_minus_density[row, seq(start_col, end_col)] <- 1
      if (length_DOW_EX<50){
        end_col <- min(end_col, start_col + length_DOW_EX -1)
        UPSEXR_minus_density[row, 0:(51-length_DOW_EX)] <- NA_real_
      }
    } 
  }
}

  geom_line(aes(y = Value1, color = "Vector1"), size = 1) + geom_line(aes(y = Value2, color = "Vector2"), size = 1)+ xlim(-50,1050)+
  labs(title = "SG-RBPs AE Binding Peaks",
       x = "Density",
       y = "Position") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Vector1 = "blue", Vector2 = "red")) +
  theme_bw()+geom_vline(xintercept = c(0,50,250,450,500,550,750,950,1000), linetype="dashed")
```


## Running

```{r}
eCLIPSE_BigExon_full <- fread("../Projects/StressGranules/AS.WC_Transcriptome/eCLIPSE/", header = T)[,-1]

betAS_file <- read.csv("../Projects/StressGranules/AS.WC_Transcriptome/eCLIPSE/RMATS_RBFOX2.csv", header = T)

eCLIPSE_BigExon_full[,1002] <- rep("RBFOX2", nrow(eCLIPSE_BigExon_full))

eCLIPSE_BigExon_full <- as.data.table(eCLIPSE_BigExon_full)
colnames(eCLIPSE_BigExon_full) <- c(1:1000,"EVENTS", "RBP")

for (rbps in (unique(eCLIPSE_BigExon_full$RBP))) {
eCLIPSE(rnamapfile = eCLIPSE_BigExon_full,
        oddsrathreshold = 4,
        pvalthreshold = 0,
        PSIthreshold = 0.05,
        pdiffthreshold=0.0,
        ASfile = betAS_file,
        rnaBP = "RBFOX2",
        plot = T)
}
```
